mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_generations (analysis_run_id, user_id, generation_status, error_message, created_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{analysisRunId}, #{userId}, #{generationStatus}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{completedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE generation_status = VALUES(generation_status), error_message = VALUES(error_message), completed_at = VALUES(completed_at)
